data.title: Foundations Group Recovery Centers Ohio Opens New Hilliard Location, Expanding Addiction and Mental Health Day Treatment Across Central Ohio
data.description: Ohio's Foundations Group Recovery Centers is set to unveil a new facility in Hilliard on October 19, 2026, boasting over 12,000 square feet of space. This expansion aims to enhance access to outpatient addiction treatment services while introducing full-day and half-day mental health day treatments. With the capacity to accommodate up to 150 clients, the facility is poised to play a vital role in addressing substance abuse and mental health needs in the region.

data.title: X1 Health Unveils Three-Supplement Daily Stack to Take the Guesswork Out of Wellness Shopping
data.description: In a recent survey, it was found that 72% of American adults have encountered diet, nutrition, or weight-loss related content on social media platforms within the past month. X1 Health is striving to provide a solution by offering three unique formulas and a daily wellness stack that are backed by science. The company is currently offering free early-access signups for those interested in learning more about their products.

data.title: TravelingWiki on Google, Bing & Yahoo as One Of World's Leading Influencers & Top Websites for Autism Travel; with SportsFanWiki Among Top Websites for Autistic Sports Fans
data.description: TravelingWiki has been recognized as one of the premier influencers and top websites for travelers with autism worldwide. This acknowledgment comes from Google, Bing, and Yahoo search engines. Similarly, SportsFanWiki has been acknowledged as one of the leading websites for sports fans with autism attending sports events. This recognition also stems from Google, Bing, and Yahoo search engines. Both websites have garnered attention and praise for their focus on autism-related travel and sports experiences. The location of the announcement was in Las Vegas.

data.title: Livermore Valley Named 2026 American Wine Region of the Year by Wine Enthusiast
data.description: Livermore Valley, a renowned wine region in California with a rich 180-year history, has recently garnered national acclaim for its dedication to excellence and genuine hospitality. The region, located in Livermore, California, was honored with the prestigious 2026 Wine Star Award by Wine Enthusiast. This recognition serves as a testament to the continued success and significance of Livermore Valley in the wine industry.

data.title: Facilis Technology Powers Up NAB Show New York 2026 with Breakthrough Network Performance, Next-Gen Security, and Deep Media Composer 2026.8 Integration
data.description: Facilis Technology has announced the release of HUB Version 8.4, offering enhanced Ethernet performance technology, improved cloud SSO security, and seamless integration with MAM for Avid Media Composer users. The update was launched in Hudson, Mass., on October 15, 2026. Facilis Technology, known for its cost-effective and high-performance shared storage solutions, is a prominent international provider.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N - American Skin Association/
data.description: American Skin Association has announced the establishment of the ASA Emerging Dermatology Leaders Advisory Committee on October 14, 2026. This committee will comprise 10 members who are emerging leaders in the field of dermatology. The purpose of the committee is to provide guidance and support to young dermatologists, fostering their professional development. The committee members will serve a term of two years before new members are selected. This initiative aims to promote innovation and collaboration in the dermatology field.

data.title: Property Management Expert Amy Reynolds Explains Rental Income Strategies in HelloNation
data.description: The key aspects for investors to consider prior to buying an investment property are detailed in the article. These involve analyzing rental income, property expenses, and potential profits. HelloNation's insights are particularly useful for those looking to make informed investments. The information was shared in FAYETTEVILLE, N.C. on October 16, 2026. By evaluating these factors diligently, investors can make well-informed decisions regarding potential investment opportunities.

data.title: Kreate Named The Home Depot Partner of the Year for Third Consecutive Year
data.description: After investing $100 million in expanding their Tiffin facility, integrating resin manufacturing, and prioritizing advancements in autonomous manufacturing, AI vision technology, and innovative products, Kreate has garnered recognition for their efforts. The company, based in Sarasota, Florida, has demonstrated a commitment to investing in people and staying at the forefront of technological advancements. This recognition comes on the heels of significant developments and investments by Kreate, showcasing their dedication to growth and innovation in the industry.

data.title: TRADESFUTURES HOSTS THE LARGEST GATHERING OF TRADESWOMEN IN THE WORLD
data.description: In Houston, more than 6,000 attendees from North America recently came together to commemorate achievements and promote the growth of opportunities for women in the construction sector. The event, which took place on October 16, 2026, saw a diverse gathering of tradeswomen, industry professionals, labor representatives, and affiliated groups showing their support for this cause.

data.title: Data Center Fire Detection and Suppression Market to Reach USD 10.35 Billion by 2035 as Battery and AI Risks Drive Protection Upgrades - DC Market Insights
data.description: The market for data center fire detection and suppression is experiencing a steady growth rate of 8.75% annually. This growth is attributed to the increasing adoption of water mist and hybrid systems in the market, leading to a shift in market share. Additionally, services such as inspection, testing, and maintenance are contributing to a larger recurring revenue pool for the industry. This information was reported from London on October 16, 2026.

data.title: Ayrton Senna's style leads the Senna brand into fashion and lifestyle
data.description: In a bid to expand its audience reach, the fashion industry is teaming up with motorsport through new partnerships. Recent collaborations have shown promising results, with research indicating that 5 out of 10 Americans who are familiar with the three-time Formula One world champion also view him as a fashion icon. This trend is particularly notable in Sao Paulo, where the influence of the brand is strong. The synergies between fashion and motorsport are proving to be mutually beneficial, tapping into a significant market segment.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N - Museum of Illusions/
data.description: The Museum of Illusions is set to debut its inaugural Northern California site in downtown Sacramento on November 6. The news was announced on October 15, 2026, through a press release from the Museum of Illusions via PR Newswire. The location will feature a range of mind-bending exhibits for visitors to immerse themselves in.

data.title: Corgi Insurance Recognized on LinkedIn's 2026 Top Startups Annual List, Ranking No. 6 in San Francisco
data.description: In the city of San Francisco, on October 16, 2026, Corgi Insurance has achieved notable recognition as it secured a position on LinkedIn's esteemed 2026 Top Startups roster. Corgi Insurance holds the impressive rank of No. 16 out of the 50 top startups in the entire United States, further solidifying its standing as a rising star in the industry. Additionally, within the San Francisco region specifically, Corgi Insurance secured an impressive position at No. 6 on the list. This recognition underscores the remarkable growth and forward momentum that the company has been experiencing as it continues to expand its operations.

data.title: Miami-Dade Breaks Annual Record for $30 Million-Plus Home Sales in Just Nine Months
data.description: In Miami, as of September 2026, Miami-Dade County has surpassed its annual record for home sales exceeding $30 million in just nine months. This milestone highlights the significant influx of wealth in South Florida, as indicated by recent data released by MIAMI REALTORS® + RWorld. The figures showcase a notable trend towards luxury real estate purchases in the region, with total sales exceeding $30 million continuing to rise rapidly.

data.title: Green Data Center Market to Reach USD 90.38 Billion by 2035 as AI Density Accelerates Liquid Cooling, Power Efficiency and Retrofit Spending - DC Market Insights
data.description: The market is experiencing a robust growth rate of 12.96% CAGR, with direct-to-chip liquid cooling segment surging to a value of USD 17.33 billion and retrofit spending expected to rise to USD 18.41 billion by 2035. This information was disclosed in a report titled "Green Data Center Market - Growth, Share, Opportunities & Competitive Analysis, 2026-2035" presented in London on October 16, 2026.

data.title: Five Stars. 10,000 Times. IVX Health Celebrates a Major Patient Experience Milestone.
data.description: A major national infusion provider based in Brentwood, Tennessee, has achieved a milestone of receiving over 10,000 five-star reviews on Google. This provider operates a network of more than 160 ambulatory infusion centers. IVX Health specializes in delivering outpatient infusion and injection therapy services to individuals with complex chronic conditions.
